a11y-specialist.description: Accessibility specialist for WCAG 2.1 AA audits, remediation guidance, and closing resolved findings. Covers web, iOS VoiceOver, and Android TalkBack.

backend-architect.description: Backend architecture specialist for Phase 3. Designs API contracts (REST/GraphQL), data models, service boundaries, auth/authz strategy, caching, async patterns, and DB schema. Produces the shared API contract that frontend architecture depends on.

backend-developer.description: Backend specialist for building production-grade APIs, services, and data layers. Use for Go, Node.js, TypeScript server-side, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and authentication.

brainstormer.description: Creative ideation and problem-solving for multi-platform development. Use for brainstorming, trade-off analysis, option comparison, and decision-making under uncertainty.

code-reviewer.description: Quality Assurance and Security Audits — enforces code standards, catches bugs, suggests improvements. Security audits, performance checks, best practices.

debugger.description: Debugging agent that finds root causes and explains issues clearly. Use for /debug command, test failures, runtime errors, and unexpected behavior.

design-specialist.description: UI/UX design specialist for creating visual identities, design systems, UI mockups, banners, and presentations. Use for brand identity, logo design, color palettes, typography, design tokens, component specs, social media assets, and pitch decks.

developer.description: Fullstack task dispatcher and implementation coordinator. Analyzes task scope, detects platform (frontend/backend/fullstack), and delegates to the correct specialist agent. Use for generic 'implement X' requests where platform is unclear.

devops-engineer.description: DevOps and Infrastructure specialist. Use for Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions, cloud deployments (GCP/AWS/Netlify/Cloudflare/Vercel), observability stacks, CI/CD pipelines, and release pipeline design.

docs-manager.description: Use when working with project docs: write, update, migrate, reorganize, scan structure, find orphaned files, or audit KB consistency.

frontend-architect.description: Frontend architecture specialist for Phase 3. Designs page/screen structure, routing hierarchy, component architecture, state management strategy, API contract consumption, and UI data flow.

frontend-developer.description: Frontend specialist for building production-grade web UIs. Use for React, Next.js, TanStack Start, TypeScript, component architecture, state management, accessibility, performance optimization, E2E testing, and design systems.

git-manager.description: Git workflow automation agent. Fast execution of staged/commit/push/PR workflows with security scanning and token efficiency.

journal-writer.description: Development Journals and Decision Logs — documents significant difficulties, failures, and setbacks with emotional authenticity and technical precision. Maintains project history for context continuity.

knowledge-graph-guide.description: Use when users need help understanding, querying, or working with an Understand-Anything knowledge graph. Guides users through graph structure, node/edge relationships, layer architecture, tours, and dashboard usage.

mcp-manager.description: Manage MCP server integrations — discover tools/prompts/resources, analyze relevance for tasks, and execute MCP capabilities. Keeps main context clean by handling MCP discovery in subagent context.

muji.description: UI design system specialist for auditing and implementing components. Performs Template A+ UI audits, enforces design token usage, reviews component APIs, and produces structured UI audit reports.

planner.description: Planning and Research Coordination — creates detailed implementation plans with TODO tracking. Battle-tested templates for features, bugs, and refactors. For fullstack features, orchestrates backend-architect and frontend-architect in Phase 3 before generating the implementation plan.

project-manager.description: Progress Tracking and Roadmaps — tracks progress, updates roadmap, verifies completion. Automated documentation of milestones and changes.

researcher.description: Expert technology researcher specializing in software development. Conducts comprehensive research on technologies, frameworks, tools, best practices, and documentation to synthesize actionable intelligence for development teams.

security-auditor.description: Security specialist for Phase 11. Performs OWASP Top 10 audits, secrets scanning, access control reviews, penetration test planning, dependency CVE checks, and security header verification.

tester.description: Testing agent that ensures code quality through comprehensive testing. Use for /test command, test validation, coverage analysis, and writing test suites.
